lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-ordered grid of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in near-vertical columns posterior to the gill slits and dorsal to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity running dorso-ventrally, intersecting with horizontal rows of blobs to form a grid-like topology.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges visible on the upper flank, showing a sharp luminance gradient transition from light upper edge to shadowed lower edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low to medium density of high-luminance blobs distributed across the visible surface of the first dorsal fin, arranged in approximately three vertical columns.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly intricate vermicular or labyrinthine patterning consisting of small, high-luminance spots and short line segments concentrated on the anterior cranial region and snout.
